overrides_applied.reason: Named 'Randgris and Reginleif Cards', but only Reginleif Card declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and ATK+5% applied from one card. Valkyrie Randgris Card's description has no set block at all.

Both daggers write the heading 'Sin Daggers:' (no 'Set') over 'First and Second', then 'Set Bonus:'. The parser read it as a condition and lost the bonus lines, so the gear search never valued the pair (2026-10-01, Night Raven Definitive Dagger build).

Gravewhisper writes 'Skull Mask Set:' then 'Critical Damage +10%' and 'while wearing Skull Mask', with no 'Set Bonus:' line, so the parser made no set and the bonus was lost (tools/audit-gear.ts, 2026-10-01).

'Double Max HP/SP' has no number to read. The project owner (2026-10-01): it doubles them -- written as a x2 multiplier on the finished pools. The other lines are restated because the override replaces the whole set bonus.

'Per 10 Refines: +3% All Bonuses (Max 12% at +40 Total)'. The project owner (2026-10-01): each of the set's per cent bonuses -- SP, HP, ATK, MATK -- goes up 3% per 10 total set refines. Four shadow pieces reach +40, so the 12% cap falls out of the steps.

'All 4 Skills Damage +10%' and 'Per 2 Refines: +1% All 4 Skills Damage. (Max 20% at +40 Total)' name no skill, so they counted for nothing. The four are the ones the pieces name, one each: Backstab (Armor), Rolling Cutter (Gloves), Double Strafe (Pendant), Cross Ripper Slasher (Shoes). Four shadow pieces top out at +40 total, which is where the 20% cap falls, so the cap needs no rule of its own (2026-10-01 audit).

Only Rank S Shadow Card mentions this set, and it writes the heading 'Full Shadow Card Set' with no colon, so the parser saw no set at all and the three lines under it became the S card's own -- the card read as granting All Stats +5 and both penetrations +10 by itself. The bonus needs all six Rank shadow cards (E/D/C/B/A/S) compounded; they take six different slots, one card each, so member_count is 6. Membership is inferred from the naming and the slots, not from any text: none of E/D/C/B/A mentions the set.

Named 'Core and Gear', but only Vesper Gear 01 declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the bonus applied from one accessory. Vesper Core01's description has no set block at all. Both are accessories and fill the two accessory slots, so member_count is 2.

Named 'Core and Gear', but only Vesper Gear 02 declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the bonus applied from one accessory. Vesper Core02's description has no set block at all. Both are accessories and fill the two accessory slots, so member_count is 2.

Named 'Core and Gear', but only Vesper Gear 03 declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the bonus applied from one accessory. Vesper Core03's description has no set block at all. Both are accessories and fill the two accessory slots, so member_count is 2.

Named 'Core and Gear', but only Vesper Gear 04 declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the bonus applied from one accessory. Vesper Core04's description has no set block at all. Both are accessories and fill the two accessory slots, so member_count is 2.

Named 'Andvarinaut + Accessory', but only Andvarinaut declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the whole bonus applied from one accessory. The second half is any one of the six Asgard status accessories -- Gleipnir, Megingjard, Brisingamen, Draupnir, Gjallar, Jarngreipr -- which is consistent with the bonus disabling the left accessory's status bonus: each of the six is the 'every 9 base <stat>' piece for one stat. Seven are listed as alternatives while two are worn, so member_count is 2.

Named 'Undershirt and Black Shirt', but only the Undershirt declares it -- it declares both shirt sets -- so this grouped as a set containing the Undershirt alone and AGI+3 applied from one garment. Black Shirt's description has no set block. Undershirt is a Garment and Black Shirt an Armor, so both can be worn and member_count is 2.

Named 'Armor, Garment, Shoes and Helmet', but only Darkness Crown declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself alone. None of the other Darkness pieces has a set block. The Crown is the Helmet; Darkness Armor and Darkness Robe are the two Armor-slot alternatives, so five items are listed but only four are worn and member_count is 4. Darkness Helm is a separate Upper headgear piece with its own effects and no set block, and is read as not being part of this. NOTE: the set bonus is left as parsed because the tooltip itself gives it as '?' -- the numbers are unknown, not mis-parsed.

The tooltip gives no members text at all -- just 'Death Set:' over the bonus -- and only DeathBound Armor declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and ATK+5%/MATK+5% applied from the armor alone. The family is the armor, the DeathCover Mantle and the DeathLand Greaves, each of which comes in an unslotted and a slotted mark. This is the unslotted mark, matched by card slots; neither mantle nor greaves has a set block of its own. Addressed by id because the two marks differ only in capitalisation ('DeathCover' vs 'Deathcover'), which is too thin a thing to key a correction on.

Necromancer's Hand Mirror repeats the whole Fallen Gods block in its description, so it grouped as a fifth member -- but it has no equip_slots and is not refineable, which is what a retired item looks like here, and the set's own refine lines name only Armor, Shoes, Gloves and Pendant. Left in, member_count is 5 while only four pieces can be worn, so the set bonus can never complete. The four named pieces are the set; the mirror is dropped.

Named 'Dark Faceworm and Queen Faceworm Cards', but only Faceworm Queen Card declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the whole bonus applied from one card. Dark Faceworm Card's description has no set block at all. The two take different slots -- Dark Faceworm is Armor, the Queen is Garment -- so both can be worn and member_count is 2. Note the members text writes 'Queen Faceworm', while the item is named 'Faceworm Queen Card'.

Named 'Hyegun, Bongun and Munak Cards', but only Hyegun Card declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and ATK/MATK+1% applied from one card. Bongun Card and Munak Card declare a set of their own instead, so they sit in both at once. Hyegun is an Armor card and Bongun and Munak each fit Garment or Shoes, so all three can be compounded at once and member_count is 3.

King's Wizard Shoes writes 'King's Guardian Set Bonus:' over the King's *Wizard* bonus -- 'Magic vs All Sizes +5%', where Guardian's is 'Defense vs All Sizes +5%' -- so the heading is a typo on the server's side and the parser grouped the shoes into Guardian by the name it declares. Everything else about the piece is Wizard: it is named King's Wizard Shoes, it sits in the Wizard id block (24424 Armor, 24425 Gloves, 24426 Shoes, 24427 Pendant), and its piece bonus 'Magic vs Small +5%' completes the family's set of sizes alongside Large on the Armor, Medium on the Gloves and All Sizes on the Pendant. All four King's shadow sets are Armor, Gloves, Shoes and Pendant, so member_count is 4.

The other half of the King's Wizard Shoes typo: with the shoes counted here this had five members and member_count 5, of which two -- King's Guardian Shoes and King's Wizard Shoes -- are shoes competing for the one shadow shoes slot, so only four could ever be worn and the set bonus could never apply. Restored to the four Guardian pieces.

Named 'Body and Legs Cards', but only Kraken Card declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the Tetragrammaton cooldown applied from one card. Kraken Legs Card's description has no set block. Reading Kraken Card as the 'Body' half: it is the only other Kraken card in the data. The two take different slots -- Kraken Card is Middle headgear, the Legs card is Garment -- so member_count is 2.

Named 'Armor and Master Weapon', but only Master Noble Suit declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and All Stats +3 applied from the armor alone. None of the Master weapons has a set block. 'Master Weapon' is any one of them, so all ten are listed as members while only two pieces are worn and member_count is 2. Master Loki Card is excluded: it is a card, not a weapon.

Named 'Garment and Card', but only Nidhogg's Garb declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the bonus applied from the garment alone. The card is spelled differently on the server -- 'Nydhogg Card', not 'Nidhogg' -- which is why nothing matched by name. It is a Garment card, so it compounds into the Garb itself, and member_count is 2.

Named 'Armors and Garment', but only Old Knight Mantle declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and ATK/MATK +10 applied from the garment alone. The plural 'Armors' is the pair of knight armors that sit either side of the mantle in the id order -- White Knight Armor (22009, Holy Element) and Khalitzburg Knight Armor (22010, Dark Element) -- which matches the mantle carrying both Holy Resistance +10% and Dark Resistance +10%. They are alternatives for the one Armor slot, so three are listed and member_count is 2. NOTE: there is no item called 'Dark Knight Armor'; Khalitzburg is read as the dark half on the element and id evidence, and is the part most worth confirming in game.

Named 'Pharaoh and Fire/Wind/Water Papilla Cards', but only Pharaoh Card declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the autocast applied from one card. The other three are spelled 'Papila' with one l on the server, which is why nothing matched. Pharaoh Card is Middle headgear and the three Papila cards are Weapon cards. Read as Pharaoh plus one Papila, because the bonus says 'the respective spell' -- so four are listed as alternatives and member_count is 2. NOTE: if a multi-slot weapon can carry two or three Papila cards at once, this is wrong and the count should be higher; that is the part worth checking in game.

The set names five cards -- 'Odium, Dolor, Despero and Maero of Thanatos + Memory of Thanatos' -- but only Memory of Thanatos declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and the bonus applied from one card. The other four are the Thanatos Set cards, which sit in both sets at once.

The set names itself 'Ring and Boots', but only the boots declare it, so the Strange Metal Ring was never grouped in and the three marks of boots were counted as three pieces of one set. They are alternatives -- one shoes slot -- so the set is two pieces: the ring plus whichever boots are worn.

Named 'Undershirt and Pink Shirt', but only the Undershirt declares it -- it declares both shirt sets -- so this grouped as a set containing the Undershirt alone and DEX+3 applied from one garment. The Pink Shirt was renamed: it is now Rabbit Pattern Shirt, which the crawler records as renamed_from 'Pink Shirt', and it mirrors Black Shirt piece for piece (level 10, one slot, HP/SP +10%, Hit +10 against the Black Shirt's Flee +10). The Undershirt's tooltip still uses the old name. Undershirt is a Garment and the shirt an Armor, so both can be worn and member_count is 2.

Named 'Armor and Weapon', but only Guillotine of the First declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and HP +5% applied from the weapon alone. Robes of the First has no set block; it is the only Armor named for the First, so it is read as the other half.

Named 'Armor and Weapon', but only Sword of the Second declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and SP +5% applied from the weapon alone. Robes of the Second has no set block; it is the only Armor named for the Second, so it is read as the other half.

Named 'Armor and Weapon', but only Bow of the Third declares it, so it grouped as a set containing itself and Move Speed +5% applied from the weapon alone. Robes of the Third has no set block; it is the only Armor named for the Third, so it is read as the other half.

Not a set. Gravewhisper's tooltip writes 'Skull Mask Set:' over what is really 'Critical Damage +10% while wearing Skull Mask' -- a condition on the one weapon -- so the parser grouped a set of one and moved the bonus onto it. Dropped here; the condition is restored by the 'Gravewhisper' item correction. Skull Mask itself is a real headgear (18868) with its own unrelated effects and no set block.

The slotted mark of the family described under 'death': Deathbound Armor, Deathcover Mantle and Deathland Greaves, matched by card slots. Only the armor declares the set, so it held one member and applied ATK+5%/MATK+5% from it alone. Addressed by id for the same reason -- the two marks differ only in capitalisation.

The Bullhorn gear comes in a slotted and an unslotted mark, named identically, and every unslotted piece but the manteau names the SLOTTED set in its tooltip. The parser therefore put all nine into this set and counted nine pieces. Split here: this set is the slotted mark only. Armor and Tunic are the two Armor-slot alternatives, so five items are listed but only four are worn -- armor or tunic, shoes, manteau, ring -- and member_count is 4. Addressed by id because the names do not distinguish the marks. NOTE: which mark the unslotted tooltips MEANT to name is a guess from the card slots, and is what is worth checking in game.

The other half of the split described under 'slotted-bullhorn': the unslotted mark, which only Bullhorn Manteau 15451 named correctly, leaving this set holding one garment and applying the whole bonus from it. Same shape as the slotted set -- armor or tunic, shoes, manteau, ring -- so member_count is 4. Addressed by id because the names do not distinguish the marks.

Two lines of the tooltip ('Permanent Endure Effect' and 'ASPD Limit +2') were read as one, so the +2 ASPD Limit went nowhere -- the limit that holds an auto-attack build's speed (the project owner, 2026-10-01).

The tooltip calls the skills its damage lines scale '3 skills': the three it gives a status to just above, New Moon Blades, Full Moon Blades and Dragon Omamori. Left to the parser, that is a skill named '3 skills' that nothing has, so the -20% and the +2% per refine went nowhere. Written out per skill here.

The tooltip reads 'HP+1% per Improve Wisdom skill level (Naturally Learned only)', which depends on a skill the planner does not model. Project owner: most thief branches learn it to level 10, so it is counted at its usual +10%. A character without the skill gets less.

The tooltip reads 'Defense Penetration +10' / 'Extra 1 % per refine' / 'Critical Damage +10%' / 'Extra 1% per refine'. Neither 'Extra' line names a stat, and taken literally the second would scale Critical Damage. The server owner says both are a mistranslation and the weapon grants +1 Defense Penetration and +1 Magic Defense Penetration per refine. Encoded that way here. NOTE: that reading leaves the flat 'Critical Damage +10%' with no per-refine line of its own, which is worth re-checking in game.

The tooltip writes 'Skull Mask Set:' over 'Critical Damage +10% / while wearing Skull Mask', which is a condition on this weapon, not a set -- so the parser invented a one-member 'Skull Mask' set and hung the bonus on it. The set is dropped under the 'skull-mask' key and the bonus is restored here as a condition, in the same shape the Bullhorn pieces use. The effects are restated too, because 'Backstab can land Critical hits' was wrapped across two lines and read as two separate unparsed effects.

The tooltip reads 'ATK+3%' / 'MATK+3%' / 'Full Shadow Card Set' / 'All Stats +5' / 'Defense Penetration +10' / 'Magic Defense Penetration +10'. 'Full Shadow Card Set' is a set heading written without a colon, so the parser read the three lines under it as this card's own and the card claimed the whole set bonus on its own. Those lines are moved to the 'full-shadow-card' set, which needs all six Rank shadow cards compounded; what is left here is the card's own ATK/MATK.

The tooltip wraps: 'Defense Penetration: 10' / 'Magic Defense Penetration:' / '10'. The label and its value are on separate lines, so the value read as a bare '10' with no stat and the magic penetration was lost entirely. Confirmed by the project owner as Magic Defense Penetration +10. Left to the parser this would mean treating an orphaned number as belonging to the label above it, which is the same shape as a continuation clause ('Extra 1% per refine') but means something different -- so it is corrected here rather than guessed at.

'Defense/Magic Defense Penetration +5' / 'Extra 1% per refine'. The continuation inherits the stat from the line above it, but its '%' disagrees with the flat +5 it continues. Read literally that is +1% per refine; the project owner confirms it is flat +1 per refine, the same reading the server owner gave for Murder Knife's identical wording. The per cent in the tooltip is a mistranslation.

'Turns 1/9 your base VIT into ATK' is ATK +1 per 9 base VIT: the server script is bonus bBaseAtk,(readparam(bVit)/9), readparam being the sheet's points. Written in the wording the parser reads (2026-10-01 audit).
'Every 10 base INT increases ATK by 1': server script bonus bBaseAtk,(readparam(bInt))/10. Rewritten as the parser reads it (2026-10-01 audit).

'MATK increased by your / base STR' was wrapped over two lines and read as nothing. Read as MATK +1 per base STR point; the item is newer than the 2023 server snapshot, so there is no script to check it against (2026-10-01 audit).
'Recover 100 SP per hit.' / 'Increases by 14 SP per refine.' -- the second names no stat. The server script is bonus bSPDrainValue,100+(14*refine): 14 more SP per hit per refine (2026-10-01 audit).
'Damage vs Fire, Earth, Wind and Water +10%'. The server script gives both halves for each element, bAddEle and bMagicAddEle +10, so it is written as physical and magic damage (2026-10-01 audit).
'Damage vs Neutral, Poison, Ghost and Undead +10%'. The server script gives bAddEle and bMagicAddEle +10 for each, so it is written as physical and magic damage (2026-10-01 audit).

'Double Attack Lv: Refine' over 'All Stats +3' was glued into one line and both were lost. Read as Double Attack at the weapon's refine level (capped at 10 like every Double Attack level), as Fallen Dagger writes it ('Double Attack Lv: = Refine (max 10)') (2026-10-01 audit).
'30% Extra "Frost Diver" Damage per Refine': the server script is bSkillAtk MG_FROSTDIVER,30*refine (2026-10-01 audit).

'8% chance to leech 3% of damage dealt.' / 'Amount increases by 1% per refine'. The amount is the leech power: +1% per refine (the 2023 server script has power 5+refine; the live tooltip's 3 is kept) (2026-10-01 audit).

'STR +1 per Hallucination' / 'Walk level' was wrapped mid skill name. Every other Limitless piece has one stat per skill level as a piece bonus, so this is STR +1 per Hallucination Walk level. 'Shadow Slash damage +6% per Blade Mastery level' is skill damage, as the 2023 server writes such lines (the owner, 2026-10-01: refer to the 2023 code); the Night Raven kit no longer adds it to the ratio itself (2026-10-01 audit).

'LUK +1 per Fury level' sits under the 'On kill with Sonic Blow:' heading, so it read as an on-kill effect. Every other Limitless piece has its stat-per-skill-level line as a plain piece bonus, so it is read as one here too; only the heal is on kill (2026-10-01 audit).

'DEX +1 per Ricochet Arrow level.' sits under 'On kill with Arrow Vulcan:'. Read as a plain piece bonus like every other Limitless piece's stat-per-skill-level line; only the coin is on kill (2026-10-01 audit).

'Adds 0.2% per base AGI scaling to the skill:' is written as a heading over 'Backstab', so it read as a condition with nothing in it. Server script: bSkillAtk RG_BACKSTAP,(readparam(bAgi)/5) -- Back Stab damage +1% per 5 base AGI (2026-10-01 audit).
'Adds 0.2% per base VIT scaling to the skills:' over 'Rolling Cutter.' / 'Cross Ripper Slasher.'. Server script: bSkillAtk on both, readparam(bVit)/5 (2026-10-01 audit).

'Adds 0.5% per base INT scaling to the skill:' over 'Envenom'. Server script: bSkillAtk TF_POISON,(readparam(bInt)/5) -- the 2023 code gives 1% per 5 INT where the tooltip says 0.5% per INT, i.e. 1% per 2. The tooltip is the live number and is used (2026-10-01 audit).

Under 'Per Refine:' the three autocast lines start with '+1%', so they were glued onto 'Thief Spells Damage +2%' and all of it was lost. Split back into the damage line and the three autocasts (2026-10-01 audit).
'Penetration +100': the project owner (2026-10-01) -- full DEF penetration. Written out as Defense Penetration so it cannot be read any other way.
'SP Regen 10%+1% per 2 base LUK': a base and a scaling run together with no sign on the first. Read as SP Regen +10%, and +1% per 2 base LUK (2026-10-01 audit).

'All 4 skills' are the four the first line names: Eruption, Flaming Petals, Freezing Spear and Wind Blade. 'Cooldown on all of them: +3 s' is read on the same four. Written out per skill so they count (2026-10-01 audit).
'All 4 skill Damage +4%' per refine names the four the gem enables just above it: Greater Explosion, Meteor Assault, Thousand Arms and Soul Destroyer (2026-10-01 audit).

'Double Attack Lv: ??'. The server script is skill TF_DOUBLE at the GS_SNAKEEYE level -- the same skill its 'Per Level of Spectral Mastery' block counts (bDoubleAddRate 10 a level) -- so Double Attack at the Spectral Mastery level (2026-10-01 audit).
'Double Attack Lv: ??': server script skill TF_DOUBLE at the GS_SNAKEEYE (Spectral Mastery) level (2026-10-01 audit).
'Double Attack Lv: ??': server script skill TF_DOUBLE at the GS_SNAKEEYE (Spectral Mastery) level (2026-10-01 audit).
'Double Attack Lv: ??': server script skill TF_DOUBLE at the GS_SNAKEEYE (Spectral Mastery) level (2026-10-01 audit).

'Double Attack Lv: ??'. The server script ties it to the same skill as the item's per-level block, which the tooltip names Spectral Mastery, so Double Attack at that level. The base-LUK lines are restated because the override replaces the item's effects (2026-10-01 audit).

'All Cast Time -5%' / 'ATK +5, MATK +5' / 'Extra 1% and +1 per refine'. One continuation covering two lines with two different units, which no inheritance rule can split on its own -- read alone it parsed as a stat literally named 'Extra 1% and'. Per the project owner the per cent is the cast time and the flat +1 is the ATK and MATK. The cast reduction stays negative because it is more of a reduction.
